name: impact-experience
title: Impact Experience Timeline
description: A light page headed EXPERIENCE, stacked with three job rows. Each row gives the company and dates, a small Position, Location, Industry and Website table, and a pair of paragraphs, and fades in a pink-orange photo when hovered.
use: A personal portfolio or CV page needs a readable, photo-backed list of past roles with details.
avoid: Three jobs and all copy are hardcoded, and the row photos need a mouse hover, so touch users never see them.
a11y: The company photos only appear on mouse hover, so keyboard and touch users never see them; the hover fades ignore reduced-motion. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Off-white page with a very large dark EXPERIENCE title sitting on a slightly tinted rounded panel. Beneath it, three full-width rows are divided by thin borders; each has a bold company name and muted dates on the left, a two-column label and value table in the middle, and grey body paragraphs on the right.
behaves: Hovering a row fades a warm pink, orange and purple photograph in behind all its columns and darkens the grey labels and paragraphs. Moving away cross-fades back to the flat pale panel.
customise: The three jobs, dates, details and paragraphs are written inside the section; each row's hover photo and the tinted panel colours need source edits.
weight: light: Three static rows with CSS opacity fades on hover; nothing runs on its own.
demo: Roles at Northline, Habitatly and Brightstack with dates, locations and fintech, real estate and SaaS industries.
issues: The frames crop the left edge, cutting the title to "XPERIENCE".
Row photos are hover-only and unreachable without a pointer.
polishWhy: Neat editorial résumé grid with a strong title; hover-only photos and a cropped heading.

frames.note: Left edge is cropped: the title reads "XPERIENCE" and frame 4 cuts "Northline".
